subject: Eval kickoff windows + mutual action outline and prompt pack ask
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Turner <oliver.turner@healix.ai>; Samira Khan <samira@healix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Eval kickoff windows + mutual action outline and prompt pack ask

Hi Oliver + Samira —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed path to get the pilot moving:

- Goal: Run a 4-week eval of Redwood inference focused on clinical note summarization and triage routing. Key success criteria we heard: 1) >= 85% accuracy on our medical entity extraction checks, 2) end-to-end latency under 300ms p95 for single-user flows, 3) reproducible prompt set for regressions.

Proposed next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (60–75 minutes) to align the trial plan, lock success criteria, and hand off the initial prompt inventory.

Two slot options (in your timezone):
- Option A: Tue Oct 20, 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Option B: Wed Oct 21, 2:00–3:15 PM PT

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & scope confirmation (10m)
2) Trial timeline & roles (10m)
3) Success criteria & measurement (15m)
4) Technical deep dive: data access, IAM, infra expectations (20m) — Ben to lead
5) Prompt set preview & evaluation plan (15m) — Monica to lead

Attached: trial-charter-draft.pdf (starter MPA), prompt-inventory-template.xlsx.

Ask from your side before the kickoff: can you share an initial list of 4–6 representative prompts or examples you want evaluated (redact PHI if needed)? Also please confirm if your engineering lead (or CTO) should join the technical deep dive.

If neither slot works, propose 30-minute windows and we’ll adjust. I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

– Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff windows + mutual action outline and prompt pack ask

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap and draft agenda. Both look good. We can do Option B (Wed Oct 21, 2:00–3:15 PM PT). I’ve tentatively held that slot on my side.

A couple of quick notes/questions before the kickoff:
- Can you confirm how data will be provided for the prompt tests? We’re likely to share de-identified sample transcripts via S3 link. Any required format constraints?
- Our CTO, Rajiv Singh (cc’d on this reply), would like to join the technical deep dive for the first 20 minutes. He’ll want to speak to IAM and audit logging.

Samira — can you pull together 4–5 example prompts (we can send redacted transcripts) by Monday so Priyom/Monica can scope the prompt pack?

Oliver
Oliver Turner
Head of Product Operations, Healix Health
oliver.turner@healix.ai | +1 (650) 555-2233

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Turner <oliver.turner@healix.ai>, Samira Khan <samira@healix.ai>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@healix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff windows + mutual action outline and prompt pack ask

Perfect — Wed Oct 21, 2:00–3:15 PM PT is locked from our side. I’ll send the calendar invite in a follow-up with conferencing details.

Quick answers and follow-ups:
- Data for prompt tests: S3 link with de-identified samples is ideal. We typically expect newline-delimited JSON or CSV with one record per example (we can accept a Zip if you prefer). I’ll add a short S3 ingestion checklist to the invite.
- Rajiv — great to have you on for the IAM/audit logging discussion. Ben will lead the technical deep dive and will cover connector/credentials patterns, KMS/HSM integration options, and what we log for SOC2/audit. Ben — would you mind preparing 5–7 slides focused on: connector options, vault/KMS patterns, and sample logging/tracing output?
- Monica — can you prepare the initial prompt evaluation rubric (accuracy thresholds, allowed hallucination tolerance, metric collection) and we’ll iterate in the kickoff?

I’ve also attached a one-page mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan-v1.docx) — it’s just a starting point to help align deliverables and owners. If the Healix procurement team wants to push a PO or an NDA before kickoff, flag that and my team will loop in Sales Ops.

Next steps I’ll take after this message:
1) Send calendar invite & conferencing link for Wed Oct 21, 2:00–3:15 PM PT
2) Attach ingestion checklist and short MPA to the invite
3) Add a short prework note: sample prompts requested by Mon Oct 19 end of day

Thanks — see you next week.

– Priyom
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.docx (DOCX, 60KB)]
